INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished editorial basketball thumbnail as a PNG, landscape approximately 16:9, target 1792x1008 (at least 1000 px wide). All text must be Japanese as specified below.

Content source: the fixed supplied article is titled "10/25 試合結果（公式記録の確定待ち）". At 2026-10-26 17:40 JST, official game records remain unconfirmed. Do NOT invent results, points, statistics, ranking, attendance, or a win. The random illustrative player is a real person, Tray Boyd III (トレイ・ボイド), selected from the article's 20 named players. He is not presented as that day's star and no appearance is asserted.

Visual art direction: approved Japanese basketball editorial ink-and-brush style, matte very dark charcoal #151A18 background, acid lime #CCF43B broad diagonal brush strokes, crisp off-white typography, sparse high-energy composition. Clearly hand-drawn illustration with visible dry brush, scratchy ink contours and limited halftone shading. Absolutely no photograph, photorealism or pasted photo. No team logos, league logos, sponsors, watermark or branded basketball.

Subject and likeness: ONE real basketball player, Tray Boyd III, likeness grounded in his official B.LEAGUE 2026-27 portrait at https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/714/2026-27/43445_03.png, which has been visually inspected. Preserve his medium-brown complexion rendered in warm grayscale, shoulder-length thin black braided/twisted hair around the face and neck, wide plain black headband across forehead, full dense rounded black beard connected to mustache, broad nose, full lips, expressive almond-shaped eyes, oval face with strong cheekbones, athletic lean muscular build. Black short-sleeved undershirt beneath plain dark basketball jersey with understated green panels. No lettering, number, crest or jewelry on clothing. Simplify arm tattoo texture into unlettered ink marks. This must resemble Tray Boyd III, not the player in the approved style sample.

Composition: fresh dynamic left-side player, torso leaning forward in a powerful low crossover-driving stance, upper body three-quarter view facing toward the right, face large and readable, one hand naturally spread against the top/side of an orange basketball near hip level, other arm extended naturally for balance. The ball is a held/touched player prop, not a standalone subject. Show head, both hands, entire ball and body down to upper thighs clearly with safe margins; deliberate lower-thigh crop is acceptable. No other people or crowd faces. This is a conceptual sports illustration, not a recreation of an actual game or a decisive play. Athlete and lime brush motion occupy left 45%; typesetting fills right 50% with generous clear space, readable at small thumbnail size. Do not cover any text with the player or brush splatter.

Typography, EXACT text only:
Small header at top right: "バスケまとめ"
Prominent date: "10/25"
Large off-white headline: "試合結果"
Very prominent lime status headline, in two clear lines: "公式記録の" and "確定待ち"
Smaller but readable qualification below: "10/26 17:40 JST時点"
Bottom footer on dark solid area, minimum 28 px equivalent at 1792 width: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "イメージ"

No player names, no player statistics, no scoreline, no match winner, no claim that Tray Boyd appeared in this game, no claim of actual scene reenactment. Do not copy any name, date, team or score from the style reference. Keep each glyph correct, no extra decorative words. Ensure natural arm/wrist anatomy and five fingers on visible hands.

ONE ALLOWED REVISION
Edit this existing basketball thumbnail with ONE targeted layout correction only. Preserve the same real-person likeness of Tray Boyd III, same pose, illustration style, colors, background, all exact Japanese text, text size, typography, text positions and the 16:9 landscape aspect ratio.
The leftmost hand/fingertips nearly touch or cross the left canvas edge and the top hair is too close to the top. Within the LEFT illustration area, scale the entire illustrated athlete AND basketball together to about 88% of their current size and shift this group slightly right/down as needed, so the outermost left fingertips and ball have at least 55px safe margin at a 1672px-wide canvas, the head/hair has at least 45px top margin, and both hands are fully visible. Keep the existing lower thigh crop if needed. Keep the right-hand Japanese title block unchanged and unobstructed. Extend only the existing dark/brush background into newly exposed space. Do not add people or anything else. Keep the illustration looking unmistakably like the same real player with thin long braids, black headband, full beard and plain black/green uniform. Keep no logos, no uniform lettering, no player name, no stats. The exact text remains: バスケまとめ / 10/25 / 試合結果 / 公式記録の / 確定待ち / 10/26 17:40 JST時点 / イラスト（AI生成） / イメージ.
